summary: Iteration 19 — OCR backend + Kid Dashboard frontend. Backend: 6/6 pytest passes on /api/ocr (happy path 'Buy Milk'+'Buy Eggs' PNG returns both lines, empty base64→400 with correct detail, unsupported mime image/svg+xml→400, oversized payload>5MB→413, data-URI prefix stripped correctly, blank white PNG returns extracted_text='' via NO_TEXT_FOUND normalisation). Frontend Kid Dashboard: empty state shows kid-empty in kid-dashboard-modal when no chores notes exist. After seeding via Tile Packs → apply-pack-chores-list, kid-picker shows 12 kid-card-<noteId> cards (Bailey, Carter, Hazel, Mason, Lawson, Evy, Josh, Matt, Child 9..12). Selecting a card opens KidBoard with kid-stat-streak, kid-stat-done, kid-stat-week and kid-chore-list all visible + 12 kid-chore-toggle-<choreId> buttons. Tapping toggle flips todo→done: line-through class applied on title, 'Waiting for grown-up ✓' amber badge appears. Second tap reverts to todo (badge disappears). kid-back-btn returns to picker; kid-exit-btn closes modal. Regression: header-insights, header-tile-packs, header-kid-mode all present. Header buttons partly hidden behind quick-access wizard overlay on first load — required JS click bypass.

integration_issues.issue: Could not verify UI round-trip via Playwright because chore-parent-approve buttons are rendered inside FullScreenNote/ChoresPanel that must be opened from list view via the AccordionNoteItem's 'Full screen' Maximize2 button — that button lacks a data-testid (still pending from iteration_18 review). Combined with data-note-id NOT being present on the row wrapper, we cannot programmatically open FullScreen for a specific note. NOT a functional bug — same logic verified in iteration_18 for streak+ledger, and KidBoard reads the same parent_approved flag via computeChoreStreak/computeNoteStreak/buildLedger.

issues: Radix DialogContent missing DialogTitle causes console warnings on every open (a11y): 'DialogContent requires a DialogTitle for the component to be accessible for screen reader users.' Wrap the internal H2 in VisuallyHidden or use DialogTitle.

action_items: Make chore-parent-approve testid unique per chore: change ChoresPanel.jsx line ~54 from data-testid="chore-parent-approve" to data-testid={`chore-parent-approve-${chore.id}`}. Current bare testid means multiple identical selectors when a note has >1 chore — automation must fall back to positional match.
Add data-testid='accordion-fullscreen-<noteId>' to the Maximize2 button in AccordionNoteItem.jsx (carried over from iteration_18) — still blocks list-view fullscreen automation.
Add data-note-id attribute to the AccordionNoteItem wrapper li/div so tests can locate a specific note's row deterministically.
Wrap the KidDashboardModal H2 in DialogTitle (or VisuallyHidden) to silence Radix a11y warning.
critical_code_review_comments: ChoresPanel.jsx: `data-testid="chore-parent-approve"` is duplicated across every chore row in the same note. Not unique — makes E2E automation and screen-reader labels ambiguous. Fix per-chore.

KidDashboardModal.jsx line 191–193: `thisWeek` uses `ledger.weekly[ledger.weekly.length-1]` under the assumption buildLedger always emits the *current* week last. buildLedger in iteration_18 emits 8 buckets ending at current week — OK, but brittle if the util changes. Safer: filter by ISO-week of today.

KidDashboardModal.jsx line 158: `done` counts chores where status==='done' && parent_approved. Card label says 'Done today' but the count is not date-scoped — it's cumulative for the note's current chore states. Should ideally filter c.history entries for today rather than reading the boolean, or label the KPI 'Approved' instead of 'Done today'.

KidDashboardModal.jsx line 21 destructures `isDark` but the modal never falls back to a system-theme detector; if a caller forgets to pass isDark, both branches render (undefined truthy=false) — parents currently always pass it, so low priority.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all Kid Dashboard flows verified; parent-approval round-trip could not be automated due to selector limitations noted above — Kid Mode side of the round-trip verified: streak KPI reads 0 while chore is only 'Waiting', which is correct)

seed_data_creation: Tile Packs → apply-pack-chores-list creates 12 chores notes under PARENT category (Bailey, Carter, Hazel, Mason, Lawson, Evy, Josh, Matt, Child 9..12). Each has 12 chores incl. 'Mow the lawn' first.
context_for_next_testing_agent: OCR endpoint fully covered by /app/backend/tests/test_ocr.py (uses Pillow to generate test PNGs). Run with `pytest /app/backend/tests/test_ocr.py -v`. Kid Dashboard tests must bypass quick-access wizard overlay via JS click (page.evaluate('el.click()')) because the intro tour overlays header buttons. To seed chores notes for Kid Mode tests: [data-testid=header-tile-packs] → [data-testid=apply-pack-chores-list] then Escape. Kid Mode selectors: header-kid-mode, kid-dashboard-modal, kid-empty, kid-picker, kid-card-<noteId>, kid-back-btn, kid-exit-btn, kid-stat-streak/done/week, kid-chore-list, kid-chore-<choreId>, kid-chore-toggle-<choreId>. For parent-approve round-trip, need main agent to (a) add unique testid to chore-parent-approve-<choreId> and (b) add accordion-fullscreen-<noteId> to AccordionNoteItem Maximize2 button.
rca of the issue: Non-unique chore-parent-approve testid + missing accordion-fullscreen testid are the sole blockers preventing full automation of the kid↔parent approval round-trip. Both are one-line fixes and were flagged in iteration_18 code review — still not applied.
